Edit image 1. It is a photo of the client's own room, and the result must still be that same room, exactly: the same camera position, angle, lens and framing; the same walls, ceiling, floor, light fixture and outlets; the same windows, with the same frames, in the same places. Do not add, remove, move or enlarge any wall, window, door or opening, do not extend, rotate or crop the room, and do not change its light. Wherever no new furniture goes, the result is image 1 unchanged.

Images 2 to 6 are the products to add, one photo each:
image 2: compact desk with drawers and cabinet, 105 cm wide, 50 cm deep
image 3: ergonomic mesh office chair, 69 cm wide, 66 cm deep, 112 cm high
image 4: low wide open bookcase, 160 cm wide, 30 cm deep, 90 cm high
image 5: glossy black articulated work lamp, size unknown
image 6: cantilever bentwood leather lounge armchair, size unknown

Add exactly these products and nothing else: no other furniture, lamps, plants, rugs or decoration than these (books on the shelves of a bookcase are fine). Each one must be the product of its photo, not a similar one: the same design, proportions, colors and materials. A product listed with "2 units" goes twice.

The client asked: "Quiero convertir este cuarto en un estudio para trabajar desde casa, moderno y sobrio: un escritorio de madera oscura frente a la ventana, una silla de oficina negra ergonómica, una biblioteca baja contra la pared, una lámpara de escritorio y un sillón chico de cuero para leer en el rincón. Negro, madera oscura y gris.". Arrange the products as an interior designer would for that, against the walls and on the floor that image 1 shows, each at its real size for this room, lit by this room's light. The result must look like a real photograph of image 1's room.
